test_cases.name: Unit Test Isolation and Coverage Threshold Configuration

details.assertion: Configures test runner thresholds for minimum 80% line coverage and 75% branch coverage
Ensures unit tests execute with zero external network or database I/O using mocks
Maintains deterministic test execution without unseeded random values or unmocked timers
Focuses individual unit tests on a single logical assertion or behavior

test_cases.name: Testcontainers Integration Test with Transaction Rollback Isolation

details.assertion: Launches ephemeral PostgreSQL container using Testcontainers singleton lifecycle
Executes database schema migrations prior to running the integration test suite
Executes each test inside a dedicated transaction that unconditionally rolls back upon completion
Guarantees test isolation and prevents mutated state pollution across test runs

test_cases.name: Post-Deployment Smoke Testing & k6 Performance SLA Verification

details.assertion: Verifies readiness probe (/health/ready) returns HTTP 200 after deployment rollout
Validates security error contracts on unauthenticated API requests in smoke test
Defines k6 performance stages for concurrency ramp-up and steady state load
Enforces strict SLA thresholds on p50 (<50ms), p95 (<200ms), p99 (<500ms), and error rate (<0.1%)
